item.title: KMT claims first win of Taiwan elections as Chen Yu-jen takes Quemoy, vows ‘real change’
item.description: Legislator Chen Yu-jen from Taiwan’s main opposition party Kuomintang declared victory in the Quemoy county race on Saturday afternoon, putting her on track to become the offshore island’s first female magistrate. Quemoy, also known as Kinmen, sits just kilometres off the coast of mainland China’s Fujian province. item.title: Hong Kong construction sector hit by cyberattack affecting 500,000 registered workers
item.description: Hong Kong’s construction sector has been hit by a cyberattack that may have exposed the personal data of about 85 per cent of its registered workers, adding to a wave of digital breaches across the city. item.title: Spain’s PM Sanchez makes final bid to head off conservatives and far-right
item.description: Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez urged voters on Friday to prevent Spain from moving “backwards” as campaigning ended for an election expected to deliver a victory for conservatives and the far-right.
